abstract: UCDP Deadly Electoral Conflict Dataset (DECO) v1.0. Georeferenced events of lethal electoral violence, covering state-based, non-state, and one-sided violence connected to elections. Harmonised copy produced by cdisaw-parquet: the (CD)ISaW ingest script for this source was run unchanged against a Parquet writer instead of PostGIS, giving 4,227 event rows in the wide 35-column layout (wide/) and an 18-column crws-nodes projection (crws/). Dataset-level domain: conflict.
